subject: Re: Redwood inference demo — timeline update
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dawson <claire@pioneer-systems.com>
Cc: Ian Park <ian.park@pioneer-systems.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood inference — proposed demo times

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Per our conversation, attached is a short agenda for a 30–45 minute technical demo focused on low-latency inference and cost controls. We have availability next week on:

- Tue 11/16 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 11/17 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu 11/18 11:00–11:45 PT

If none of those work, happy to send a few additional windows — or I can coordinate a shorter internal show-and-tell for your product team. Attachment: pioneer-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0193

Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference for production
From: Claire Dawson <claire@pioneer-systems.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ian Park <ian.park@pioneer-systems.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood inference — proposed demo times

Vanessa,

Really appreciate the proposed windows and the agenda — looks well scoped. Unfortunately, our roadmap just shifted during today's leadership review: the team is redirecting investment toward a big analytics/data-platform sprint for Q1 and pushing LLM experiments to the back burner for now.

Can we pause scheduling the demo for the moment? I'd rather not take up your team time while internal priorities are realigning. We expect to re-evaluate in late Q1 (Feb) and will circle back if the priority returns.

Thanks for understanding — will keep you posted.

Best,
Claire
Claire Dawson
Senior PM, Data Products | Pioneer Systems
claire@pioneer-systems.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dawson <claire@pioneer-systems.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood inference — proposed demo times

Understood — thanks for the quick update, Claire.

Aditya / Monica — looping you in to park this opportunity and capture next steps on the account. Pioneer is shifting spend to analytics for the next two quarters and asking us to hold off on demos.

Claire — totally make sense to pause. Two quick notes:

1) We can park the demo and set a tentative reminder for Feb 2027. Would that work (we can adjust once you have a clearer timeline)?
2) I’m attaching a lightweight deck that your leadership might find useful when they re-evaluate LLM projects — it has a short slide on cost/latency tradeoffs and the Dedicated option for predictable throughput. Attachment: redwood-inference-deck-v2.pdf

If you prefer, Aditya can send a one-page summary that you can share with finance/leadership. We’ll put a follow-up reminder in HubSpot and avoid additional outreach until you give the green light.

Take care,
Vanessa
--
Vanessa Ortiz | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Ian Park <ian.park@pioneer-systems.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Claire Dawson <claire@pioneer-systems.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood inference — proposed demo times

Thanks, Vanessa. I reviewed the deck with our infra lead — helpful overview. To be explicit for planning: leadership wants any LLM spend deferred until our analytics migration completes (projected end of Q1). We would be open to revisiting in early Feb, but nothing is committed.

Two asks from our side:

- Could you send a one-page executive summary we can drop into our leadership packet?
- Can you confirm any minimum contract terms or procurement blockers we should raise early?

If you can send those items, we’ll include them in the Feb re-eval. Otherwise, thanks for understanding us pausing for now.

Ian Park
Director, Engineering | Pioneer Systems
ian.park@pioneer-systems.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Ian / Claire — noted. I’ll put together a concise one-pager that highlights deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private), expected cost ranges for a small pilot, and procurement considerations (SLA/add-on options, standard T&Cs).

We’ll aim to send that by EOD Wednesday and I’ll create a HubSpot reminder for 2027-02-07 to check back. Link to HubSpot task: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/tasks/td-9876

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dawson <claire@pioneer-systems.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood inference — timeline update / demo parked

Claire — following up to confirm we’ve parked the live demo and documented next-touch. Summary of the thread:

- Pioneer has deprioritized LLM experimentation and moved spend to an analytics migration through Q1 2027.
- Redwood has provided a condensed deck (redwood-inference-deck-v2.pdf) and initiated a one-page summary (Aditya).
- Redwood created a HubSpot reminder for 2027-02-07 to revisit. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

We’ll avoid proactive outreach until your team asks us to resume. If anything changes sooner, just reply to this thread and we’ll re-open scheduling. Thanks again for the candid update — we’ll stay on stand-by.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
